source_prompt:
Produce a production game sprite atlas, not concept art or a poster.
Transparent alpha background. Precisely 4 equally spaced columns and 6 equally
spaced rows. Each cell is exactly the same size. Every cell contains ONE complete
full-body side-view pixel-art adventurer FACING RIGHT. Each ROW is one different
character; columns are: neutral idle, alternate breathing idle, left foot forward
walking, right foot forward walking. Feet at identical baseline, identical SCALE
and POSITION within the four cells of a row. Pixel-perfect hard edges, authentic
low-resolution 32x40-pixel sprite aesthetics, 12-colour palette per model, thick
readable one-pixel outlines and clear equipment. No text, labels, grid lines,
floor, cast shadow, glow blur, background objects, or particles. At least 10%
transparent padding around EVERY model in EVERY cell, all weapons contained.
Dark fantasy underground hearth roguelite. Primary palette: charcoal #0E090E,
warm ink #1A1420, pale ash #EEE6DC, ember #E8963C, gold #F0C470 and cool ash
#8A93B5, with shade/tint derivatives. All models MUST be recognizably different
IN SOLID BLACK SILHOUETTE. Body proportions, tools, posture, clothing outline and
headgear matter; DO NOT make recolours of one base body. Each walking frame
genuinely changes the leg/arm pose, not merely translating the image.

Rows, top to bottom:
1. CUTLER: compact knife maker with angular hood, short leather waistcoat, wide arms carrying two clearly visible knives.
2. COLLIER: bent-backed coal miner, heavy sacks on both shoulders, flat mining cap with tiny ember lamp and pickaxe across back.
3. STOKER: muscular bare-armed furnace feeder with high stiff hair, large open coal bucket at side, wide stance and thick apron.
4. HEARTHKEEPER: triangular floor-length cloak, small crownlike hood, ornate large key and raised low brazier, solemn guardian.
5. HEDGER: medium spiky thorn-shouldered scout, rounded thorn hoop, layered short coat and long thin boots.
6. MILLER: very broad mill worker carrying circular grinding wheel on back, soft low cap and a flour sack.
